context_stem: However, these recommendations will drive important aspects of our work:
excerpt: We use these recommendations as the north star for our risk mitigations planning as well as our public policy work. We will strive to advance these recommendations through a mixture of example-setting, addressing unsolved technical problems, advocacy through industry groups, and policy advocacy.
paraphrase: The recommendations guide risk mitigation planning and public policy work, advanced through multiple advocacy channels.

context_stem: However, these recommendations will drive important aspects of our work:
excerpt: We have also adopted a set of competitor-contingent commitments (see Appendix A) aimed at staying in line with these recommendations in scenarios where we can be confident that other relevant AI developers are doing the same.
paraphrase: Anthropic has adopted competitor-contingent commitments to align with the recommendations only when confident peers do likewise.

excerpt: At this point in AI's rapid development, we cannot presently give highly specific advance detail on what evaluations will determine whether risk thresholds have been passed, or what risk mitigations will be needed to achieve safety.
paraphrase: Anthropic cannot yet specify in advance the exact evaluations or mitigations needed given rapid AI development.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: In developing these standards, we have weighed the risks and benefits of frontier model development.

excerpt: Our recommendations for industry-wide safety are thus structured around requiring analysis and arguments making a strong case for safety, rather than AI Safety Levels (more in Appendix B).
paraphrase: The recommendations require safety-case arguments rather than fixed AI Safety Levels, detailed further in Appendix B.

excerpt: This leaves flexibility in how risk thresholds are evaluated and how safety is achieved and argued for. But it creates a challenge: one actor's view of what constitutes good risk assessment and mitigation may be very different from another's.
paraphrase: The flexible safety-case approach creates the challenge that different actors may hold very different views of adequate risk assessment.

excerpt: Ultimately, the best way for these recommendations to be implemented is likely via governance of all relevant frontier AI developers by third parties that determine which developers need to provide risk analyses and make arguments for the safety of their systems, and determine which such arguments are adequate.
paraphrase: Implementation is best achieved via third-party governance determining which developers must provide safety arguments and judging their adequacy.

excerpt: To the extent this takes the form of national regulation, different countries should attempt to harmonize their governance, including standards of evidence, to avoid a race to the bottom.
paraphrase: National regulations should be harmonized across countries, including evidentiary standards, to avoid a race to the bottom.

excerpt: In the shorter run, independent bodies (standards-setting organizations, auditors, etc.) might review such arguments and enforce high quality for private AI developers via voluntary mechanisms.
paraphrase: In the near term, independent bodies could review safety arguments and enforce quality via voluntary mechanisms.

excerpt: We expect that the recommendations for industry-wide safety will evolve significantly, as we learn more about AI capabilities, threat models, and risk mitigations. We hope these recommendations will become increasingly specific over time.
paraphrase: Anthropic expects the recommendations to evolve significantly and hopes they become more specific over time.

excerpt: Note that an AI developer might provide a single analysis covering a broad category of models, such that there isn't a new analysis needed for each release.
paraphrase: Footnote 2 notes a single analysis might cover a broad category of models rather than requiring per-release analysis.

excerpt: Additionally, determinations of which AI developers need to provide such analysis should be made with an effort to spare smaller AI developers from unnecessary compliance burden.
paraphrase: Footnote 2 also states smaller developers should be spared unnecessary compliance burden when determining analysis requirements.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chem/bio weapons production / Capability or usage threshold
context_stem: Row: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Capability or usage threshold
excerpt: AI systems with the ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds (e.g., undergraduate STEM degrees) create/obtain and deploy chemical and/or biological weapons with serious potential for catastrophic damages.
paraphrase: This row defines the threshold as AI capable of substantially helping individuals with basic technical backgrounds create or deploy catastrophic chem/bio weapons.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: CBRN-3: The ability to significantly help individuals or groups with basic technical backgrounds (e.g., undergraduate STEM degrees) create/obtain and deploy CBRN weapons.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chem/bio weapons production / Mitigations-our plan as a company
context_stem: Row: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company
excerpt: We will maintain or improve on our ASL-3 protections, which include classifier guards at least as robust as our initial Constitutional Classifiers; access controls for trusted users with exemptions to classifier guards; red-teaming, bug bounties, and threat intelligence for continually assessing the threat of jailbreaks; and a number of noteworthy security controls.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to maintaining or improving ASL-3 protections including classifier guards, trusted-user access controls, red-teaming, bug bounties, and security controls.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: The ASL-3 Deployment Standard and the ASL-3 Security Standard, which protect against misuse and model-weight theft by non-state adversaries, are required.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chem/bio weapons production / Mitigations-our plan as a company
context_stem: Row: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company
excerpt: Specifics may change, but we will maintain equally or more robust measures over time and will publish updates in our Risk Reports.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain equal or greater protection robustness over time and report updates in Risk Reports.

locator: Table 1 / Non-novel chem/bio weapons production / Mitigations-our plan as a company
context_stem: Row: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production; Column: Mitigations—our plan as a company
excerpt: We expect to continuously meet the criteria in the right column, although we cannot make guarantees about an evolving landscape with continually adaptive attackers.
paraphrase: Anthropic expects to continuously meet the industry-wide criteria but cannot guarantee this given adaptive attackers.
